forecast_definition: Any observed dose-rate bin > training-only threshold in the next 6 consecutive five-minute bins
feature_timing: Features available at end of current five-minute bin
weather_reason: Optional variant. A weather record is used only after both its observation time and the returned record's submission time; zero means no storm report in the feed, not Kp 0.
prior_metrics_status: User-reported preliminary scores, not reproduced; cannot transfer to this cleaned split
lab_use: Rules/reference only; no pooled clinical ML training
unit_caveat: uGy absorbed dose rate; not personal effective dose or clinical exposure limit
weather_caveat: All storm and particle reports fall on 2-17 May 2024. The validation days (20-24 May) and test days (25-30 May) contain none, so these columns cannot be shown to help on held-out data.
